title: Heatilator Gas Fireplace | Masonry Style | Installed in Manhattan Amentities Space | Hospitality
description: Heatilator Heirloom 50 Gas Fireplace installed in this Manhattan amentities space. The Heirloom provides authentic masonry style without the costs of a site-built masonry fireplace. One of the largest viewing areas in it’s class showcasing intense fires, textured brick interior panels, powerful heat and high-efficiency performance🔥
